title: ARCS Rosetta — operational definitions + artifact vocabulary
note: The single vocabulary the lab surfaces and JSON exports speak. v1: seeded from memory + canon; not exhaustive. Extend, don't fork.

Receipt.what: A decision state-vector frozen in time — a coordinate on the manifold, not a document. The atom of ARCS.
Receipt.maps_to: The DEWY-shaped export below is a Receipt serialized.

DEWY.what: The receipt schema — the decomposition of a decision into D/E/W/Y.

shape.D: the sharpened question — what you are actually deciding
shape.E: the entity — who/what else is in the terrain
shape.W: the window — today / this week / this quarter / years

DEWY.maps_to: ADR (a DEWY decision promoted to an architectural record), Codex (a DEWY receipt entry in the coursed narrative).

ADR.what: Architecture Decision Record — a durable, numbered decision promoted from a receipt when it governs how the system is built.
ADR.maps_to: Promoted from a DEWY receipt; cited in Canon.

Codex.what: The coursed, searchable narrative surface of an engagement — receipts read as a story, exhibit by exhibit.
Codex.maps_to: Renders Receipts + Recoil; one of the four polyform exhibits (recoil / codex / receipt-close / diamond).

Forge.what: The pattern that mechanizes one SSOT into a family of surfaces (the polyform). The public/redacted method page at forge.arcs.care.
Forge.maps_to: Produces Codex, Recoil, Receipt-close, Diamond exhibits from one SSOT.

Canon.what: The ratified body of ARCS law — ROM primitives, ADRs, operational definitions. What must never be violated.
Canon.maps_to: Composed of ADRs + this Rosetta; the SOT the Corpus is graded against.

Corpus.what: The full body of source material an engagement is grounded in — calls, notes, emails, decks, docs — before synthesis.
Corpus.maps_to: Refined into Receipts; graded against Canon.

Recoil.what: The kinematic telemetry of an engagement — the open-to-close diff, conviction peaks/collapses, redacted by tag. Observability of the decision.
Recoil.maps_to: One of the four polyform exhibits; feeds the Observatory dataset.

operational_definitions.confidence: Belief that a claim is TRUE. (Distinct from conviction.)
operational_definitions.conviction: STABILITY of a position under pressure — how solid/shifting/flat/entangled the gradient is.
operational_definitions.NCI: Net Coherence Index — whole-decision coherence, not any single field. The product-side nci_score is a different thing from the Commit-NCI (ADR-035) that grades code changes.

y_gate.FORK: path selection — traversing onto a slab closes options
y_gate.SCRATCH: outer fog — orient only, don't commit
y_gate.RED: free-solo topology — any slip unrecoverable; add protection or change the climb

operational_definitions.earned_fidelity: Render only at the resolution the data supports, verbatim-anchored. Never render more certainty than the receipt's Y-state deserves.
operational_definitions.NOTOMATION: Scaffold/sequence cognition; never compress, replace, or overrule revealed preference. Recommend, never act, on any ruin edge.

motions._note: The three motions of the invariant shape — beautiful operational definitions AND candidate product features (surfaced on forge.arcs.care).

Ladder.def: Read the shape up or down — atom to pipeline, pipeline to atom — same in either direction. Zoom to any altitude without re-learning it.
Ladder.feature_candidate: A zoom control across the Russian-doll nesting (atom → molecule → organism → meta).

Cascade.def: The shape propagates forward — each application seeds the next, cost dropping each time (A→D each cheaper than the last).
Cascade.feature_candidate: The seed-chain: a receipt seeds the next surface / the next person.

Spiral.def: The shape reverberates and returns changed — same-at-every-zoom, but the loop advances (record → receipt → update → record).
Spiral.feature_candidate: The compounding loop: outcome-matched receipts feed back to sharpen the next bet.

master_pattern.def: Every ARCS surface is one self-similar loop, nested like Russian dolls at every scale. Value leads as experience (the reward embodies how-to-read); the mechanism is pulled, not pushed.
master_pattern.sequencing_law: Design for the arriving cognitive state (System-1, in-fire) — lead with the fire + one action, collapse the mechanism.

scope.global: This registry (artifacts, operational_definitions, master_pattern) is global ARCS canon — applies across every project.
scope.project_specific: Engagement Codex/Recoil/Corpus instances are project-specific; they conform to these global shapes but carry their own content. Never embed a real counterpart's data in a global artifact.
